$comment: POST-SWAP ELEMENT CENSUS for the activity-element-granularity mission (T4, D6). NOT a golden manifest and NOT a gate -- no test reads this file. It is the instrument the mission's three element swaps (T1 polyline->line, T2 circle->ellipse, T3 one <text> per line) are measured against: diff-baseline.json records HOW WRONG each activity fixture is and diff-census.json records WHICH DIFF PATHS carry the weight, but neither says WHICH SVG ELEMENT moved, so three sequenced swaps against those two pins alone would be individually unattributable (D6). Population: the 268 status:"baseline" fixtures of oracle/goldens/svg-activity/diff-baseline.json -- the 82 status:"error" and 23 status:"jar-error" entries are excluded, since an unrenderable fixture and a jar error page both carry no meaningful element counts and must never read as zero (D8/D12 of plans/activity-oracle-harness/decisions.md). Every number is a pure function of the committed corpus at measuredAgainstCommit, measured through the IDENTICAL seams the ratchet gate uses: tests/oracle/svg-conformance/render-fixture-activity.ts#renderFixtureActivity with a DeterministicMeasurer and tests/helpers/fixture-include-store.ts#fixtureIncludeStore(), then compareSvg(ours, golden, 'deterministic'). `tags` counts ELEMENTS OF EACH TAG in the NORMALIZED tree (tests/oracle/svg-conformance/normalize.ts), ours vs the committed jar oracle at test-results/dot-cache/activity/<slug>/in.svg -- normalized, not raw, so the counts are exactly what the comparator sees (comments, processing instructions and whitespace text dropped). `childCountDelta` is ours-minus-jar summed over every ROOT-GROUP child-count diff -- the diffs whose path matches ^svg/g[N][childCount]$ -- read out of compareSvg's own Diff records, never from a hand-rolled tag counter, and `childCountWeight` is the weight those same records carry. That family is the mission's target: 209 records holding 99321 of 108447 total weight (91.6%). A NEGATIVE childCountDelta means we emit FEWER root-group children than the jar, which is the expected sign here -- we draw one <polyline> where the jar draws N <line>, and one <text> carrying <tspan> children where it draws one <text> per line. The totals block restates the mission README's element table; if it stops reproducing, the corpus moved and the mission's premise must be re-derived rather than assumed.
